properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-only weak keys: cmd/ceremony and wfe2 unit tests generate real 1024-bit RSA keys (rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 1024)) as fast fixtures to exercise the PKCS#11-mocked ceremony rsaGenerate path and the WFE's rejection of sub-2048-bit RSA account keys. No production 1024-bit key is created; sizes are chosen for test speed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Production SHA-1 in the issuance path: truncatedHash computes a 7-byte truncated SHA-1 over public Subject/Issuer DN bytes to derive NameID lookup keys, deliberately matching the OCSP CertID KeyHash convention (per comment). Non-collision-sensitive purpose — an internal index key over public data — but it is a live SHA-1 use in Boulder's core issuance library.

properties.name: pqs:context

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.27.0)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Boulder's complete Go crypto/tls session surface on Go 1.27.0 defaults: the public WFE2 ACME endpoint, internal gRPC mTLS mesh, DNS-over-TLS resolver, VA HTTP/TLS-ALPN probers, CT publisher, observer probers and SaaS clients, plus test/load-gen clients. Go 1.27 offers X25519MLKEM768 hybrid by default for TLS 1.3 (since Go 1.24); TLS 1.2 fallback remains classical ECDHE — the harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure lives there and with non-hybrid peers. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Boulder's certificate linter (cpcps = CA/Browser Forum CP/CPS profile lints) instantiates crypto/ecdh curves (P-256/P-384/P-521) and parses certificate public keys as ECDH keys to classify which keys in issued certificates are ECDH-capable, and to reject cross-certified/TLS subordinate and root CA certificates that use them. No key agreement is performed by Boulder itself — this is cert-profile policy code that governs which quantum-vulnerable curves the CA will accept in certificates it lints.

properties.name: pqs:context
